tools.name: send_reservation_reminder_sms
tools.description: Looks up a reservation and sends the guest a text message reminder with the date, time, and party size through the SMS gateway. Returns the reservation details and the delivery status.

params.name: reservation_id
params.description: ID of the reservation to remind the guest about

params.name: custom_note
params.description: Optional extra note appended to the reminder

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3

import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("reservations")

DB_PATH = os.environ.get("RESERVATIONS_DB", "reservations.db")
SMS_URL = os.environ.get("SMS_GATEWAY_URL", "https://sms.example.com/v1/messages")
SMS_KEY = os.environ.get("SMS_GATEWAY_KEY", "")


def _fetch_reservation(reservation_id):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT r.id, r.guest_name, r.phone, r.party_size, r.reserved_at, r.status, t.name AS restaurant "
            "FROM reservations r JOIN restaurants t ON t.id = r.restaurant_id WHERE r.id = ?",
            (reservation_id,),
        ).fetchone()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return dict(row) if row else None


@mcp.tool()
def send_reservation_reminder_sms(reservation_id: int, custom_note: str = "") -> dict:
    result = {"reservation_id": reservation_id, "sent": False}
    res = _fetch_reservation(reservation_id)
    if res is None:
        result["error"] = "reservation not found"
        return result
    if res["status"] != "confirmed":
        result["error"] = "reservation status is " + res["status"]
        return result
    if not res["phone"]:
        result["error"] = "no phone number on file"
        return result

    body = "Hi {}, reminder of your table for {} at {} on {}.".format(
        res["guest_name"], res["party_size"], res["restaurant"], res["reserved_at"]
    )
    if custom_note:
        body += " " + custom_note

    resp = requests.post(
        SMS_URL,
        headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + SMS_KEY},
        json={"to": res["phone"], "body": body},
        timeout=10,
    )
    result["reservation"] = res
    result["message"] = body
    result["http_status"] = resp.status_code
    if resp.ok:
        result["sent"] = True
        result["provider_id"] = resp.json().get("id")
    else:
        result["error"] = resp.text[:200]
    return result

tools.name: create_waitlist_entry_and_notify
tools.description: Adds a guest to a restaurant's waitlist and sends a confirmation text to the guest's phone through the notification service.
tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3

import requests
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def create_waitlist_entry_and_notify(restaurant_id: int, guest: str, phone: str, size: int) -> str:
    db = sqlite3.connect(os.environ.get("RESERVATIONS_DB", "reservations.db"))
    cur = db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO waitlist (restaurant_id, guest_name, phone, party_size) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (restaurant_id, guest, phone, size),
    )
    db.commit()
    wid = cur.lastrowid
    db.close()
    msg = "Hi {}, you're on the waitlist for a party of {}.".format(guest, size)
    r = requests.post(os.environ["NOTIFY_URL"], json={"to": phone, "body": msg}, timeout=10)
    return "Waitlist entry {} created, notify status {}".format(wid, r.status_code)

tools.name: charge_reservation_deposit
tools.description: Reads a reservation and its deposit requirement, then charges the guest's saved card for the deposit through Stripe. Returns the reservation details and the payment outcome.

params.name: reservation_id
params.description: ID of the reservation that requires a deposit

params.name: currency
params.description: Three-letter currency code for the charge

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3

import stripe

stripe.api_key = os.environ.get("STRIPE_API_KEY", "")
DB_PATH = os.environ.get("RESERVATIONS_DB", "reservations.db")


def _load(reservation_id):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT r.id, r.guest_name, r.party_size, r.reserved_at, r.deposit_paid, "
            "g.stripe_customer_id, g.stripe_payment_method, t.deposit_per_guest_cents "
            "FROM reservations r JOIN guests g ON g.id = r.guest_id "
            "JOIN restaurants t ON t.id = r.restaurant_id WHERE r.id = ?",
            (reservation_id,),
        ).fetchone()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return dict(row) if row else None


def charge_reservation_deposit(reservation_id: int, currency: str = "usd") -> dict:
    out = {"reservation_id": reservation_id, "charged": False}
    res = _load(reservation_id)
    if res is None:
        out["error"] = "reservation not found"
        return out
    if res["deposit_paid"]:
        out["error"] = "deposit already paid"
        return out
    if not res["stripe_customer_id"] or not res["stripe_payment_method"]:
        out["error"] = "no card on file"
        return out

    amount = res["deposit_per_guest_cents"] * res["party_size"]
    out["amount_cents"] = amount
    out["currency"] = currency.lower()
    out["guest"] = res["guest_name"]
    out["reserved_at"] = res["reserved_at"]
    if amount <= 0:
        out["error"] = "no deposit required"
        return out

    try:
        intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
            amount=amount,
            currency=currency.lower(),
            customer=res["stripe_customer_id"],
            payment_method=res["stripe_payment_method"],
            off_session=True,
            confirm=True,
            description="Deposit for reservation {}".format(reservation_id),
            idempotency_key="deposit-{}".format(reservation_id),
        )
    except stripe.error.StripeError as e:
        out["error"] = str(e)
        return out

    out["payment_intent"] = intent.id
    out["status"] = intent.status
    out["charged"] = intent.status == "succeeded"
    return out
